description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing 'Defect' entities, including custom query methods for counting defects by status and severity, and retrieving defects within a time range.

classes.name: DefectRepository
classes.description: A repository interface for Defect entities, providing data access methods including custom queries.

methods.name: countByStatus
methods.description: Counts the number of defects with a specific status.

methods.name: countBySeverity
methods.description: Counts the number of defects with a specific severity.

methods.name: findByCreatedAtBetween
methods.description: Finds all defects created within the specified time interval.
